source: Derived from COLP (fn4k-qyk2) ownership + MapPLUTO lot polygons
definition: A campus is a set of lots sharing an owner/agency label whose polygons are within SNAP_DEG of each other, dissolved into one polygon. This is a PROXY for a commonly-operated portfolio — not an official boundary, and not evidence of a shared plant or meter.
limitation: Private campuses (Rockefeller Center, Penn/Vornado) need a PLUTO ownername pass; this build covers city-agency ownership only.
